verdict.rationale: The accounting API and MCP layer that would let an agent draft/post journal entries programmatically are explicitly described as forthcoming ('Soon, a full accounting API...', 'an MCP layer will let AI agents handle bookkeeping tasks end-to-end'), not shipped, and probes confirm no live OpenAPI or llms.txt endpoint exists today. While Command can draft journal entries and accountants can be invited in-product, there is no evidence of an API-driven agent workflow or a review-queue mechanism for accountant sign-off.
